notes: These are inference credits, not general compute. The vendor contradicts itself on expiry: the pricing FAQ says the credit is 'available until you use it up' and contrasts it with free tiers that 'expire after 12 months', while the managing-projects documentation says promotional credits expire one year from signup. A third-party deal page reports both readings and advises planning for 12 months (grabaicredits.com, 2026, reported). Treat the 12-month reading as the safe one; the console balance is the only authority for a given account. The 'over 700 hours' figure is the vendor's, and 775 hours is our division at the pre-recorded Nova-3 rate. Not probed: no account was created. Re-read on 2026-10-23: the pricing page states no expiration and the terms end the balance at account closure, so the 12-month caution above remains the safe reading.
